description: This file defines a WorkerExecutor class for managing web workers, including worker pool management, task execution with timeout handling, and event handling utilities.

classes.name: WorkerExecutor
classes.description: A class to manage a pool of web workers, execute tasks with timeout, and handle worker lifecycle.

methods.name: _getWorker
methods.description: Retrieves a worker from the pool or creates a new one if none are available.

methods.name: _createWorker
methods.description: Creates a new web worker instance.

methods.name: _handleTaskEnd
methods.description: Handles cleanup after a task completes, including terminating or recycling the worker.

methods.name: _processQueue
methods.description: Processes the task queue, assigning tasks to available workers.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Queues a task for execution in a worker, with optional timeout handling.
